entries.title: Of the Eight Virtues
entries.excerpt: Mercy, Truth, Honor, Humility, Justice, Devotion, Insight, Courage — these are the pillars of a life well lived in Avermere.

entries.title: Lord Avermere, the Reigning Sovereign
entries.excerpt: Of the line of British, monarch since the founding. He answers to the Eight before he answers to the throne.

entries.title: On Moongates
entries.excerpt: Eight gates, eight phases, eight Virtues. Where they lead is governed by the moons; when they open is governed by the stones.

entries.title: The Iron Marches, the Far Country
entries.excerpt: Beyond the Pillars of the Argentrock Isle lies a sea of green; beyond that, a stranger continent under colder stars.

entries.title: Ratticus, Brigand-Captain of Blacktarn
entries.excerpt: A creature of low cunning and lower humility. Reportedly bears a stolen sigil-ring of Honor.

entries.title: The Companions of the Avatar
entries.excerpt: Erevan, Theran, Bron, Eris, Geoffrey, Jaana, Julia, Katrina. Each binds to a Virtue; together they are the Avatar's mirror.
